title: Branch and Bound for Relational Verification of Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.13118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verification of neural networks against relational specifications, such as global robustness, is crucial for safety-critical applications of cyber-physical systems (CPS), given their increasing adoption of AI components. Compared to simple trace properties (e.g., local robustness), verifying relational specifications requires reasoning about the relationship between multiple network inferences, which brings significant technical challenges. translated_title: 神经网络关系验证的分支定界方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13118v1 公告类型：新 摘要：针对关系规范（如全局鲁棒性）的神经网络验证，对于网络物理系统（CPS）的安全关键应用至关重要，因为这些系统越来越多地采用AI组件。与简单的轨迹属性（例如局部鲁棒性）相比，验证关系规范需要推理多个网络推断之间的关系，这带来了显著的技术挑战。现有研究探索了基于神经网络输出的声音且凸过度逼近的抽象技术；然而，由于这些方法本质上是不完备的，可能产生误报，这进一步凸显了对有效抽象细化的需求。在本文中，我们提出了一种分支定界（BaB）框架来缓解此问题，该框架迭代地分割问题，直到所有子问题都被验证。具体而言，我们的BaB框架具有关系分割的特点。
tldr: 本文提出了一种分支定界框架，通过迭代分割关系验证问题直到所有子问题被验证，以解决神经网络关系验证中抽象方法不完备和误报的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a branch-and-bound framework that iteratively splits relational verification problems until all subproblems are verified, addressing the incompleteness and false alarms of abstraction methods in neural network relational verification.
